# orion apply

Apply a plan of cards, notes, groups, and links in one step

```sh
orion apply [file] [options]
```

| Argument                | Description                                              |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[file]`                | Plan file: a JSON list of operations, or - to read stdin |
| `--plan <value>`        | The plan as inline JSON, instead of a file               |
| `--dry-run`             | Preview the plan without writing                         |
| `--if-revision <value>` | Write only if the document has this revision             |
| `--json`                | Print JSON                                               |
